name: Sítio Roberto Burle Marx
description: Sítio Roberto Burle Marx is the former country estate of the Brazilian landscape architect and artist, set in the western part of Rio de Janeiro. Begun in 1949, it served as his living laboratory, where curving beds, bold sweeps of colour and some 3,500 tropical plant species sit beside native Atlantic Forest, mangrove and coastal sandy plain. It is the first modern tropical garden on the World Heritage List.
